definitions: To convey (water, gas, or other fluid) through pipes.
To play (music) on a pipe instrument.
To utter (a high-pitched sound or song).
To look at or observe (someone or something).
examples: The plumber pipes the water to the new tap.
She pipes a beautiful melody on her flute.
The bird pipes its morning song.
The chef pipes cream onto the cake.
He pipes the new arrivals from his window.
